Parking in Barrie is becoming easier and more convenient by providing more options, new technology and better balance for residents and visitors. Learn more about Barrie's Parking Strategy at barrie.ca/parkingstrategy.


This map reflects Barrie’s parking infrastructure and options may be temporarily limited by construction projects of special events. Check barrie.ca/parking for any temporary closure notices.
Effective May 1, 2026, the non-resident waterfront parking permit annual rate is increasing to $150 (+ HST), and the neighbouring municipality waterfront parking permit will no longer be available.
Waterfront Rate Price Increase
Effective May 1, 2026, parking rates in waterfront and hybrid areas have been updated from $10/hour and $50/day to $15/hour and $60/day.
